title: Unit 4 Consolidation
goal: Review verbs of influence, value judgments, reactions, the infinitive or que + subjunctive and polite recommendations, and read a text about Carlos Fuentes.
grammar: Review: influence, will and value judgments

items: Review the subjunctive after verbs of influence, value judgments and reactions.
Review the choice between an infinitive and que + subjunctive, and polite recommendations.
Read a text about the writer Carlos Fuentes and his novel La muerte de Artemio Cruz.
I can ask, advise or recommend that someone do something with que + subjunctive.
I can give a value judgment or a reaction with que + subjunctive.
I can decide between an infinitive and que + subjunctive when I speak.
I can read a short text about a writer and his novel.
